pages.text: A collapse leaves a crater inside a much larger $(danger)dark energy zone$(). It never fades on its own.$(br2)It's dangerous, but it's also the only source of several rare materials.

pages.title: Size and border
pages.text: A reactor holding the ignition minimum of mass leaves a zone $(num)500$() blocks in radius. More mass, bigger zone: $(num)4x$() the mass doubles the radius, from $(num)150$() up to $(num)2,000$() blocks.$(br2)Its edge is a black wall you can see from far away. It bursts outward from the crater behind a violet shock front the moment the core collapses.

pages.title: Inside
pages.text: Inside, the world looks like it's seen from within a black hole: the view swirls and bends.$(br2)$(thing)Gravity is weak$(): everything falls at $(num)40%$() speed, jumps higher and takes less fall damage. Mobs float too.

pages.title: Corrupted ground
pages.text: Bare ground turns to $(item)Corrupted Stone$() a few blocks deep, chunk by chunk as they load. Plants die off.$(br2)Trees, water and anything you built are left alone.

pages.title: Corrupted mobs
pages.text: Hostile mobs born in the zone are $(danger)corrupted$(): twice the health, harder hits, faster, armored, trailing purple sparks.$(br2)They drop $(item)Void Dust$(), and rarely a $(item)Graviton Core$().

pages.title: Unstable ore
pages.text: Nodes of $(item)Unstable Dark Ore$() dot the corrupted ground, thickest on the crater floor. Mining one gives $(item)Dark Matter Shards$(), but about one in four $(danger)discharges$(): it hurts, but breaks nothing.

pages.title: The crater
pages.text: Once the crater stops falling in, a few glowing $(item)Singularity Glass$() and $(item)Event Horizon Fragments$() are left at the bottom. They never despawn.$(br2)Singularity Glass is what $(l:operation/research)captures$() a black hole.

pages.title: Closing a zone
pages.text: Use a $(item)Charged Dark Matter Crystal$() on an ore node inside the zone. The node turns to stone and the wall glides inward.$(br2)A zone needs $(num)8$() stabilized nodes. After the last one it falls in on itself and is gone.

pages.title: Config
pages.text: Server owners can change the zone's size and limits, the gravity, the node count, the ore and discharge chances, and turn corrupted mobs off.$(br2)With collapse block damage off, the ground is never corrupted.
